description:
• Brand introduction: bioVITALITY is dedicated to providing advanced, science-backed health products that bridge the gap between modern research and natural wellness. As the exclusive distributor of Foerde f2M Microbiota in Australia and New Zealand, we focus on enhancing gut health with innovative, clinical-grade probiotics that cater to your body’s unique needs.


• Product description: f2M Microbiota is a next-generation probiotic solution containing a powerful blend of 31 live bacterial strains. Developed through advanced fermentation techniques, f2M supports a healthy gut microbiome by promoting balance and regulating the immune system. This probiotic spray delivers approximately 1 billion living bacteria per milliliter and is designed to restore gut health, enhance digestion, and improve overall well-being.


• USP (Unique Selling Point): 

f2M Microbiota stands out as a revolutionary probiotic spray, unmatched in both strain diversity and functionality. It features a blend of 31 live bacterial strains—a combination of aerobic and anaerobic bacteria—which no other probiotic in the world offers. This unique formulation adapts to your body's specific needs, restoring gut balance and enhancing immunity like no other product on the market.

What further differentiates f2M is its prebiotic solution, infused with  fruits and herbs used in traditional eastern medicines for thousands of years. These natural ingredients provide essential nutrients that foster the growth of beneficial bacteria, ensuring a thriving gut microbiome.

Additionally, f2M’s spray format offers a versatile application. Not only does it support gut health, but it can also be applied directly to the skin. This makes it an effective solution for preventing infections and accelerating wound healing, offering a dual benefit that extends beyond traditional probiotics.

This combination of strain diversity, prebiotic support, and versatile application positions f2M Microbiota as a cutting-edge solution for both internal and external health, making it truly one of a kind.


• Payment terms: 

Flexible payment options available. Affiliates receive a commission based on successful sales tracked through the UpPromote system. Payments will be processed monthly through secure platforms.


• Other information: 

  • Storage: Store in a cool, dry place away from direct sunlight. Once opened, refrigerate to maintain potency.
  • Certifications: Manufactured to the highest standards in Germany, ensuring safety and effectiveness.
  • Customer Support: Dedicated support team available for any product or shipping inquiries.
